idea: Turn times into rates: a job done in t hours means t1​ of the job per hour. Rates working together add; a drain subtracts. Work done = rate × time.
trap: Adding the times instead of the rates.
desmos: Desmos can solve a1​+b1​=t1​ for you, but it can't tell you that rates, not times, are what add.

items.stem: Pump A can fill a tank in 5 hours, and pump B can fill the same tank in 3 hours. Working together, how many hours do the two pumps take to fill the tank?
items.explain: Pump A fills 51​ of the tank per hour and pump B 31​. Together: 51​+31​=158​ per hour, so the job takes 815​ hours.
